reviews.shade: numbuzin No.1 Pantothenic B5 Active Soothing Cream 80ml Duo Set
reviews.text: My holy grail for my dry and sensitive skin. I could not even count how many times I've purchased this cream. I also love how it doesn't have any scent at all and how my skin looks glowing and healthy. I got a lot of compliments after using this moisturizer.
reviews.zh: 對我嘅乾性同敏感肌嚟講，係我嘅神級產品。我已經買咗好多次呢款面霜，數都數唔清。我仲好鍾意佢完全冇味道，用完皮膚睇落有光澤、好健康。用咗呢款保濕霜之後，我收到好多讚美。

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.1 Pantothenic B5 Active Soothing Cream 80ml Duo Set
reviews.text: 그것은 좋고 진정 성분이 많이 언급되어 있으며, 오일 컨트롤에 좋지만 몇 번 사용한 후 피부가 망가졌습니다…
reviews.zh: 呢款好，標榜有好多舒緩成分，控油效果好，不過用咗幾次之後皮膚就被弄壞咗……

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.1 Pantothenic B5 Active Soothing Cream 80ml Duo Set
reviews.text:
I have combination, dehydrated skin, and this moisturizer has become a staple in my routine. I'm currently on my third bottle, which says a lot about how much I enjoy it.

It provides excellent hydration without feeling heavy or greasy. The lightweight texture makes it perfect for summer, keeping my skin comfortable and well-hydrated throughout the day.

I also love using it under makeup. It absorbs quickly, doesn't pill, and creates a smooth base that helps my makeup apply beautifully and last well.

For my combination, dehydrated skin, it strikes the perfect balance between hydration and a lightweight feel. I will definitely keep repurchasing it. 💙✨
reviews.zh:
我係混合偏乾、缺水嘅皮膚，呢款保濕霜已經成為我日常護膚嘅必備品。我而家用緊第三樽，足以證明我幾鍾意。

保濕效果好好，唔會覺得厚重或者油膩。質地輕盈，夏天用好啱，全日都令皮膚保持舒適同水潤。

我仲好鍾意喺化妝之前用。好快吸收，唔會搓泥，塗完個底好平滑，有助化妝品推得靚、維持得耐。

對於我呢種混合偏乾、缺水嘅皮膚，佢喺保濕同輕盈感之間取得啱啱好嘅平衡。我一定會繼續回購。💙✨

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.1 Pantothenic B5 Active Soothing Cream 80ml Duo Set
reviews.text: i recently just started using this one after finishing all the other ones i was using (i am in the process of trying to declutter my stuff). i dont think i can fully give it 5 stars for that reason, but i really like it so far. its very moisturizing and light weight. i love the toner and the serum from this line so i didnt expect any less!
reviews.zh: 我最近先開始用呢款，因為之前嗰啲用完咗（我而家正努力清理自己嘅物品）。我覺得唔可以因為咁就畀滿分，但係我目前好鍾意。保濕力好強，質地又輕盈。我好鍾意同一系列嘅化妝水同精華，所以我本來就冇諗過會差！

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.1 Pantothenic B5 Active Soothing Cream 80ml Duo Set
reviews.text: because it’s lightweight yet leaves my skin feeling calm and balanced. I do add a layer of Vaseline after it dries for extra moisture, especially when my skin feels drier than usual. Once my skin got used to it, I noticed a subtle glow that made my complexion look healthier overall. If you’re looking for a gentle product that offers a soothing effect, this cream is a great option (soap for size comparison)
reviews.zh: 因為質地輕盈，但係用完會令皮膚感覺平靜、平衡。乾咗之後，我會再加一層凡士林，特別係皮膚比平時乾嗰陣，保濕會更加足。皮膚慢慢適應咗之後，我留意到好細微嘅光澤，令整體膚色睇落更健康。如果你想搵一款溫和、有舒緩效果嘅產品，呢款面霜係個好選擇（附上肥皂作尺寸比較）。

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.1 Pantothenic B5 Active Soothing Cream 80ml Duo Set
reviews.text:
My favorite numbuzin line. This moisturizer along with the powder and the soothing pads have helped my acne and pie (post inflamatory acne redness) incredibly!
Results are amazing, it does not leave an oily feeling but the skin does feel very moisturized.
reviews.zh:
我最鍾意嘅 numbuzin 系列。呢款保濕霜，連同粉末同舒緩棉片，對我嘅暗瘡同 PIE（暗瘡炎症後紅印）都大幅改善咗！
效果好好，唔會有油膩感，但係皮膚真係好滋潤。

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.1 Pantothenic B5 Active Soothing Cream 80ml Duo Set
reviews.text: Reminds me of the Dr. G moisturizer but BETTER. My first impression of the Dr. G moisturizer was that it was ok. It did what it needed to do and that was about it. Didn’t provide like that extra hydration. HOWEVERRRR, this moisturizer… she does her thing well. She’s not overly moisturizing but she does provide that extra hydration. Andddd its perfect for my acne prone skin/ combo skin ppl 🙌
reviews.zh: 令我諗起 Dr. G 保濕霜，但係更加好。我對 Dr. G 保濕霜嘅第一印象係「還可以」。佢做到應該做嘅嘢，但就只係咁。冇提供到嗰種額外嘅保濕。不過，呢款保濕霜……佢表現好好。佢唔係過分保濕，但係確實提供咗額外嘅水分。而且好啱我哋易生痘／混合性皮膚嘅人 🙌

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.1 Pantothenic B5 Active Soothing Cream 80ml Duo Set
reviews.text: Mi hermana y yo tenemos una especie de rutina. Nos gusta compartir el skincare y después platicar cómo nos fue. Ella tiene piel normal pero muy sensible y mi piel es mixta tirando a grasa. Le di la crema en tubo a ella y yo me quedé con el de bote. A ambas nos gustó mucho esta crema, por lo general nos gustan más las texturas tipo gel. Se absorbe muy bien y se siente la hidratación que deja hasta la mañana siguiente. Tal vez para las personas de piel seca no sea suficiente pero a nosotras nos encanta. Volveré a comprar de nuevo!
reviews.zh: 我同我姊妹有個類似固定嘅習慣。我哋會分享護膚嘢，之後傾下各自嘅感受。佢嘅皮膚係正常但好敏感，我嘅皮膚係混合偏油。我將管裝面霜畀咗佢，我自己就留低樽裝嗰款。我哋兩個都好鍾意呢款面霜，一般嚟講我哋都比較鍾意凝膠質地。好快吸收，保濕感可以維持到第二朝，好明顯。對於乾性皮膚嚟講，可能唔夠，但係我哋就好鍾意。會再買！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
